title: Teleporter Pill
wikitext: {{Infobox/Item |rarity = r |slayer_level_requirement = Blaze Slayer 4 |id = TELEPORTER_PILL |raw_materials= *512 Derelict Ashe *2560 Red Sand *25600 Mycelium *10240 Magma Cream *10240 Glowstone Dust *10240 Nether Wart *10240 Blaze Rod *20480 Sugar Cane *10240 Ender Pearl *2 Inferno Vertex |mat_cost_bazaar=*4 Molten Powder *128 Enchanted Sugar *32 Enchanted Eye of Ender *2 Inferno Vertex }} A '''Teleporter Pill''' is a {{Rare}} [[Permanent Consumables|Permanent Consumable]]. It is unlocked at {{Coll|Blaze Slayer 4|icon=yes}}. Consuming it permanently unlocks the ability for the player to teleport to their {{zone|Private Island}} {{Item|Teleport Pad}}s from anywhere on the {{zone|Private Island}}. == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{Coll|Blaze Slayer 4}} |A1 = Molten Powder |B1 = Enchanted Sugar, 64 |C1 = Molten Powder |A2 = Inferno Vertex |B2 = Teleport Pad, 64 |C2 = Inferno Vertex |A3 = Molten Powder |B3 = Enchanted Sugar, 64 |C3 = Molten Powder |Output = Teleporter Pill }} }} == Usage == Right-clicking a '''Teleporter Pill''' consumes it, unlocking the '''Teleporter Pads menu''', a menu which allows the player to teleport to any {{Item|Teleport Pad}} on the player's own {{Zone|Private Island}} while on it. The menu can be accessed from the SkyBlock Menu or via /teleportsNote the suffix "s" cannot be omitted). It can only be opened while the player is on their {{Zone|Private Island}}. == Trivia == *The '''Teleporter Pill''' has the same texture as the {{Item|Placebo Bracelet}}. * The '''Teleporter Pill''' previously required {{Item|Enchanted Cake|amount=128}}s, making it uncraftable even with [[Quick Crafting]] due to {{Item|Enchanted Cake}}s being unstackable. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2022/March 8|link=none|[[File:Teleporter Pill.png|26px]] Added '''Teleporter Pill'''.}} |beta= {{History|2022/April 20|[[File:Teleporter Pill.png|26px]] Added '''Teleporter Pill'''.}} {{History|2022/April 29|Changed the recipe to using 128x {{Item|Enchanted Sugar}} instead of 128x {{Item|Enchanted Cake}}, allowing the item to be quick crafted.}} {{History|0.18|Updated the description to reflect being able to work on the [[Garden]].}} {{History|2023/May 22|link=none|No longer works on the [[Garden]].}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Slayer/Blaze}}
